repairedFindings: Valid bytes returned by stdout/stderr reads are captured within existing bounds before post-read cancellation/deadline rejection; rejected reads remain failed protocol steps.

stderr empty reads are observations rather than permanent seals; read/write/close perform later bounded nonblocking probes, while EOF descriptors are excluded from readiness polling to avoid empty-read spinning.
additionalAtomicity: Buffered stdout frames are removed only after the final rejection gate, retaining data if cancellation/deadline occurs after copying.
criticalAssertions: Late private bytes survive but no identity attestation, GO send or receipt promotion occurs.
Private stderr cap and overflow evidence remain intact on late reads.
Initial and previously observed stderr EOF do not hide later bytes in read, write or close.
Repeated readable EOF remains bounded under the fake-clock poll budget.
Existing owned-fd cleanup and sticky failure checks remain passing.

independentReview.scope: three changed FIFO files and two approved fixes

limitations: FIFO and systemd scenarios are local doubles, not actual native acceptance.
Controller fixture uses preprepared mock artifacts and does not prove full preparation-budget integration.
Native parent-fd/manager-view proof, persistent bus connector, kernel/resource attestation and original diagnostic-worker bootstrap integration remain pending.
synchronization: Sanitized verification evidence only; no private experimental source, raw stderr, exception bodies or credentials published.
